<thought>We need to list all possible precursor sets for the retrosynthetic step using template 1914395. The mapped reaction shows the product (with fluorine) and the reactant (the corresponding alcohol). Applying the template in reverse gives a single precursor molecule: the alcohol version of the product. The unmapped SMILES for this precursor is O[C]1CCN(CCc2ccccc2)C1. Therefore the answer is a list containing one inner list with this SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"O[C]1CCN(CCc2ccccc2)C1\"]]</final_answer>
